# Fairness findings of uni20B2 in the regular font which are known: kind x y direction status: reason.
inflection 640 214 90 intended: the right-hand edge of the stem of the G runs from the convex outer edge of the lower arc straight up into the concave bracket of the right head serif, as on the G (The Currency Signs and the Letterlike Signs)
inflection 609 600 135 intended: the hollow before the tip of the beak of the G, which the sign takes unchanged (The Currency Signs and the Letterlike Signs)
